name: EPIC 206028487
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 16.7 solar radii and 1.42 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206028487 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.719079 (16th-84th percentiles 15.698762-17.828066), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,102 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.42 solar masses and 16.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,567 K at its surface.
